token_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='andrew_brow@gmail.com', password='kWuKkrH')
access_token = token_resp['access_token']

# fetch all my playlists (public + private)
all_playlist_ids = set()
for is_public in [True, False]:
    i = 0
    while True:
        page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, is_public=is_public, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
        if not page:
            break
        for p in page:
            all_playlist_ids.add(p['playlist_id'])
        i += 1

playlist_ids = sorted(all_playlist_ids)
print('playlist_count', len(playlist_ids))
print('playlist_ids', playlist_ids)

# fetch my following artists
following = {}
i = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_following_artists(access_token=access_token, query='', page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=None)
    if not page:
        break
    for a in page:
        following[a['artist_id']] = a
    i += 1

print('following_count', len(following))

reggae_artist_ids = set()
reggae_tracks = []

for pid in playlist_ids:
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token)
    print('playlist', pid, pl['title'], 'songs', len(pl.get('songs', [])))
    for s in pl.get('songs', []):
        song_id = s['id']
        song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song_id)
        genre = (song.get('genre') or '').lower()
        if 'reggae' in genre:
            reggae_tracks.append((song_id, song.get('title'), genre, [a['id'] for a in song.get('artists', [])]))
            for a in song.get('artists', []):
                reggae_artist_ids.add(a['id'])

print('reggae_tracks_count', len(reggae_tracks))
print('unique_reggae_artists', len(reggae_artist_ids))
print('reggae_artist_ids_sample', sorted(reggae_artist_ids)[:20])

# determine which artists need to be followed
need_follow_ids = [aid for aid in sorted(reggae_artist_ids) if aid not in following]
print('need_follow_count', len(need_follow_ids))
print('need_follow_ids_sample', need_follow_ids[:20])
